value.rationale: Quantifies the entire leading dependence kernel between natural lower and upper boundary counts in a canonical probabilistic poset model, supplying every fixed joint-cell first correction and a simultaneous unique-boundary probability beyond known marginals. The rank-one factorization describes a nontrivial global finite-size interaction that disappears in the weak limit; this is mathematically motivated and not merely an isolated numerical invariant.
